purpose: GenRec public-data model expansion; not a claim of private industrial scaling or exact bitwise training parity

fuxi_alpha.origin: independent padded PyTorch implementation; external source used only as numerical/data oracle

fuxi_beta.origin: independent reconstruction; actual upstream FuXiBeta/FBGEMM/loss used only as numerical oracle
mechanisms: per-head position then signed-clamped power-time channels

fuxi_gamma.origin: independent reconstruction of the released dense causal base
mechanisms: learned RMSNorm gains and separate SwiGLU FFN

wukong.origin: independent paper reconstruction; existing MIT-attributed GenRec feature adapter reused
mechanisms: input-conditioned attentive Y with explicit reconstruction choices

paper_criteo_recipe.search: 3000+ configurations; ranges include 1-4 blocks, FMB/LCB output8 or16, rank24

public_config.dataset: frozen Criteo_x1 exposure parquet; vocabulary fitted only on train

assumptions: attentive Y: linear feature compression to4 tokens, ReLU MLP 4D->128->fields*rank; exact source construction undisclosed in paper
post LayerNorm normalized over all output fields and embedding dimensions
ReLU head, Xavier-normal dense initialization and embedding std1e-4 are public adaptation choices
no matched Terabyte data or original mixed-optimizer training; no direct headline paper-AUC replication claim

sequential_recipe.dataset: frozen original ML1M CSV/catalogue, raw IDs and catalogue order retained
sequential_recipe.selection: fixed final epoch100, no validation selection
sequential_recipe.precision: FP32 encoder, BF16 CUDA loss interactions, TF32 enabled
sequential_recipe.evaluation: full catalogue; remove history; source next-target timestamp; top2500 MRR with fallback rank2501
sequential_recipe.loader_difference: GenRec shuffle and4 workers versus upstream DDP sampler and8 workers/prefetch128; RNG stream not identical

padding_erratum.effect: not configuration-identical to source; retain records but exclude from aligned paper comparisons

cases: full base shape, lengths200/117; all parameter shapes checked
all6040 train and6040 test rows through actual upstream features helper
numerical_validation.full_cuda: output/loss allclose; per-parameter gradient relative-L2 <=1e-3 due padded/jagged roundoff and BF16 rounding; AdamW deltas recorded, not an equality pass
numerical_validation.material_observation: full CUDA beta first AdamW step differs by max0.0019745822; do not describe full-shape CUDA optimizer updates as equal

tokenmixer_adam_fp32.comparison: same public recipe as prior Adam/FP32 RankMixer; model capacities/tokenization/heads differ
tokenmixer_adam_fp32.interpretation: recipe transfer, not single-factor optimizer ablation
